issue.author: nikic
issue.body:
```llvm
target triple = "arm64-apple-macosx11.0.0"

define <1 x i64> @test(<1 x i64> %v.val) #0 {
  %fshl = tail call <1 x i64> @llvm.fshl.v1i64(<1 x i64> %v.val, <1 x i64> %v.val, <1 x i64> splat (i64 1))
  ret <1 x i64> %fshl
}

attributes #0 = { "target-features"="+sha3" }
```

comments.author: davemgreen
comments.body: Same thing happens with the old XAR code: https://godbolt.org/z/xMMjYY817. We should be either excluding v1i64 types or handling them with inserts/extracts to  v2i64.

comments.author: davemgreen
comments.body: The original probably had the xor. The code was updated in https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/commit/36bb17aa6544c1f62309a6162555262f282e1d13 to handle more cases.
